author: supervisor (Claude) under human direction; isolated bake-off worktrees off detector0-win-20260528
purpose: Decide empirically whether a reduced 'shortcut' Detector 0 target set (learn both hands, keep face/body as fixed anchors, drop the table union) reaches the same outcome as the 'full' multi-target set, and define a measurable success gate for any learned Detector 0.

method.data: data/annotations/detector0/return-to-form-tier0-localization-packet-v0.json (32 hand-labeled frames: train 11 / val 11 / test 10, 5 PopSign words).
method.device: local Mac Studio MPS; no Brev, no remote, no paid compute, no pretrained deps
method.protocol: 12 seeds (1-12) full-train per arm + a train-size sweep at 4/7/11 rows over seeds 1-6; all hyperparameters at script defaults (max-epochs 250); only the learned-target set differs between arms.
method.fair_comparison_note: median_constant_box_mean_iou is data-only (seed-invariant) and matched the prior single-run all-targets receipt exactly (head 0.951, body 0.949, right 0.648, left 0.407), confirming identical data loading across arms.

key_correction: The constants LEARNED_RUNTIME_TARGETS / FIXED_GEOMETRY_TARGETS / DIAGNOSTIC_TARGETS in the multitarget script do NOT drive the training gradient in the original code (they are runtime/reporting metadata used by classify()). The original training loss optimizes all five targets. The strict-gate contract's '3 fixed + 1 learned right hand' is therefore a runtime/reporting policy, not what training optimizes. The shortcut arm gated the loss to the two hands via a minimal edit and verified gradient isolation (non-learned targets' learned IoU == constant IoU at std 0.0).

results_full_arm.reason: the full-arm agent run was declined; the prior single-run all-targets receipt return-to-form-tier0-detector0-multitarget-gaussian-policy-v1.json is used as a full-config proxy
results_full_arm.interpretation: Full-config proxy hand IoU (~0.28 left / ~0.69 right) is within noise of the shortcut arm (0.32 / 0.61); neither configuration's learned hands beat the fixed-box baseline at 32 frames. Full vs shortcut is effectively a tie at this data scale.

conclusion: At 32 labeled frames a LEARNED coarse Detector 0 overfits and is WORSE than a fixed-geometry box on held-out hands; learning beat the fixed baseline in 0 of 12 seeds.
head_or_face and upper_body_or_signing_space reach ~0.95 IoU from a fixed median box; learning does not improve them. Detection value is entirely in the two hands.
The shortcut (learn hands, fix face/body, drop union) loses nothing versus full at this data scale; the binding constraint is labeled data, not architecture or compute.

Materially more labeled rows are required before a learned detector can exceed the fixed baseline. The loop cannot manufacture labels; added rows come from manual contact-sheet/visual-overlay annotation on already-approved Tier 0 PopSign frames and from source-reviewed hard negatives.

success_gate.definition: A learned Detector 0 may be called an improvement, promoted, exported, or activated only when a retrained model BEATS the fixed-box baseline on held-out test and then trends toward the product spec.
success_gate.until_gate_met: claim surfaces stay fail-closed; the fixed-geometry baseline remains the operative Detector 0.

design_decision.rationale: Face/body are ~0.95 as fixed anchors and stable; spend learned capacity and annotation labor on the hands, which are the discriminative and difficult targets and where ASL sign location is encoded relative to the face anchor.

brev_status: Verified working on 2026-05-29 (read-only ls/org + a start/SSH/GPU smoke on the retained L40S; the prior M3HI 'provider blocker' was a post-start sshd race + rotating IP, not an outage). Compute is not the Detector 0 constraint; labeled data is. Do not start Brev for Detector 0 until a gate-targeting training run needs scale.
claim_boundary: Diagnostic only. Does not promote Detector 0, does not change model cards, does not activate browser recognition, does not claim ASL correctness or readiness.
isolation: Run in throwaway git worktrees off detector0-win-20260528 (bakeoff-det0-full / bakeoff-det0-shortcut); main and the live loop branch were untouched.
